topic: Build a personal AI assistant in 30 minutes for free
angle: Claude Projects + Perplexity + one custom prompt = 90% of what people pay $30/month for.
hook: How I built my own AI assistant in 30 minutes without spending a rupee
caption:
Everyone wants a personal AI assistant like Jarvis. Almost everyone thinks it requires a paid subscription. It does not. Claude Projects gives you memory. Perplexity gives you search. One custom prompt ties them together. Total build time: 30 minutes. Total cost: zero. What would you have your AI assistant do first?

slides.text: How I built my own AI assistant in 30 minutes without spending a rupee
You need a free Claude account. Nothing else. No subscription. No coding.

slides.title: Create a Claude Project
slides.body: In Claude.ai, click Projects → New. Name it. Upload your notes, resume, or key documents. Claude will remember them across every chat.

slides.title: Add a custom instructions block
slides.body: In Project settings, paste your personal context. Your goals. Your writing style. Your calendar. Claude uses it every time.

slides.caption: setup time from zero to a working personal AI assistant

slides.text: 1% of Claude users touch Projects. Everyone else uses the default chat and wonders why paid AI feels smarter.
Save this. Set up your Project tonight and reply with what you named yours.
